subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: After the request defect and proof gap are resolved, should Crabbox core own this dedicated private AWS workspace service and its IAM, network, SSM, and operating contract?
rationale: The PR creates an ongoing security-sensitive service deployment and operational responsibility that cannot be accepted solely from unit tests or automated code review.

options.title: Own it after live proof
options.body: Accept the service only after corrected code and redacted target-account evidence establish the complete documented lifecycle and security posture.

options.title: Keep generic primitives only
options.body: Retain reusable AWS credential and provider capabilities but move the dedicated deployment stack and operating contract outside core.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged until a maintainer explicitly sponsors the service and its ongoing operational ownership.

recommendation.title: Own it after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept the service only after corrected code and redacted target-account evidence establish the complete documented lifecycle and security posture.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior merged history shows the strongest ownership of Crabbox's AWS provider and coordinator integration.
